page.overview:
Who is Zombie Horse?

Baby:Height: 0.8 BlocksWidth: 0.6982 Blocks : Adult:Height: 1.6 BlocksWidth: 1.4 Blocks Baby:Height: 0.8 BlocksWidth: 0.7 Blocks

A zombie horse is an undead variant of the regular horse. Zombie horses appear to be the horse equivalent of zombies. Like zombies, zombie horses are green-skinned and their eyes are completely black.

Zombie horses spawn naturally in plains, savannas, snowy plains, ice spikes, etc. in the form of a zombie horseman jockeys.

Zombie horses may be created by the command, with their spawn egg, or by naturally spawning as a zombie trap horse. When using a spawn egg, 20% spawn as foals.
